label: rig:suite
setup: mkdir -p "$RIG_JSON_DATA/simd-json" "$RIG_JSON_DATA/simdjson" && for d in simd-json simdjson; do [ -e "test/json/data/$d" ] || ln -s "$RIG_JSON_DATA/$d" "test/json/data/$d"; done && flock "$RIG_JSON_DATA/.lock" tools/fetch-json-data.sh && zig build -j"$CPUQ_CORES" -Dself-check=true
